source_caption: Al Pacino stated that he suffered embezzlement by a corrupt accountant in 2011 and lost all of his money. Broke and desperate for funds, he accepted the role in Jack and Jill (2011). “’Jack and Jill’ was the first film I made after I lost my money,” Pacino explained. “To be honest, I did it because I didn’t have anything else.” 👀

source_details.title: Jack and Jill
source_details.synopsis: Jack and Jill is a 2011 American comedy film co-written by and starring Adam Sandler in a dual role as the titular twin siblings. Directed by Dennis Dugan, the film also stars Katie Holmes and Al Pacino. It tells the story of an advertising executive who dreads the Thanksgiving visit of his unemployed twin sister, who overstays into Hanukkah at a time when he is instructed to procure Al Pacino's appearance in an upcoming Dunkin' Donuts commercial. Jack and Jill was released on November 11, 2011, by Sony Pictures Releasing.
